svg.title: From the literature to the research gap
svg.desc: Funnel of five layers narrowing from satellite NO2 as a tracer of urban combustion, through deep learning and graph neural networks, to the overlooked difference in reach and the gap that no study holds reach equal; below it, the contribution of this study: reach, not graphs.
svg.text: Satellite NO₂ traces urban fossil combustion
TROPOMI maps NO₂ daily at a few km; used to locate CO₂ plumes and test inventories
Beirle et al. 2019 · Goldberg et al. 2024 · Ahn et al. 2025 · Rey-Pommier et al. 2025
Deep learning maps urban emissions and air pollution
From satellite images, road networks, buildings and points of interest
Zeng et al. 2024, 2025 · Yap et al. 2025 · Shao et al. 2026 · Teng et al. 2026
GNNs: the gains are credited to the graph
Learned message passing between neighbouring places
Wang et al. 2020, 2025 · Zhao et al. 2026 · Mohseni et al. 2026
But a GNN also sees further
Its reach grows with every layer; baselines see far less
Luo et al. 2016 · Liang et al. 2023 · Schmidt & Ong 2026
No study varies the reach of GNN and baselines alike
191 records screened; reach audit of 11 studies (Table 1)
GNN and spatial-lag models compared at the same reach
